definitions.explanation: Electromagnetic radiation used for communication, broadcasting, and other technological applications.
In casual usage, refers to the quality of wireless signal reception.

examples.japanese: {電波|でんぱ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
{電波|でんぱ}⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.notes: {電波|でんぱ}⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧ = radio-controlled clock

notes:
TECHNICAL USE:
- {電波|でんぱ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発信|はっしん}→発信：04895_hasshin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to transmit radio waves)
- {電波|でんぱ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受信|じゅしん}→受信：04896_jushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to receive radio waves)
- {電波|でんぱ}⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧ (radio interference)
- {電波|でんぱ}⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (Radio Law)

EVERYDAY USE:
- {電波|でんぱ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (poor signal/reception)
- {電波|でんぱ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}らない→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (no signal)
- {電波|でんぱ}⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧ (radio-controlled clock)

SLANG (dated): {電波|でんぱ}⟦{系|けい}→系：noentry⟧ was used to describe someone who seems disconnected from reality or has strange ideas (not recommended to use).

SCIENCE: {電波|でんぱ} is part of the electromagnetic spectrum, with frequencies lower than infrared.
